jobgether-jobgether:lever:3aa7ae4f-e5b7-.title: Business Analyst –Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration
jobgether-jobgether:lever:3aa7ae4f-e5b7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Mexico. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9edb530f-9d97-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst based in Canada . This role supports better business decision-making by transforming data into clear, practical insights. You will collect, organize, and analyze information from internal systems, spreadsheets, and business reports. The position focuses on identifying trends, patterns, and performance indicators without requiring deep programming expertise. You will create accessible dashboards, visualizations, and reports that help stakeholders understand business performance. Working closely with different teams, you will clarify reporting needs and ensure the underlying data is accurate and consistent. The role also provides opportunities to contribute to ad hoc analysis, recurring reporting, and improvements to data processes. It is well suited to a detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working with data and communicating insights in a business context. Gather, organize, and validate data from internal systems, spreadsheets, reports, and other business sources. Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, performance indicators, and insights relevant to business objectives. Prepare clear visualizations, charts, dashboards, and summary reports for business stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand reporting requirements and translate business needs into useful data outputs. Support recurring reporting processes and respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests. Review data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before reports and insights are shared with stakeholders. Maintain documentation related to reporting processes, datasets, definitions, and methodologies. Help establish and maintain consistency across reporting workflows and business metrics. Apply basic data governance and privacy principles when handling and reporting business information. Requirements Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, data organization, and basic analysis. Familiarity with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio. Strong ability to interpret data and translate findings into meaningful business insights. Excellent attention to detail, with a methodical approach to identifying inconsistencies or potential data quality issues. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and understanding different reporting needs. Basic understanding of data governance, data quality, and privacy principles. Ability to manage recurring reporting responsibilities while responding efficiently to ad hoc requests. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks. A practical, business-oriented mindset and genuine interest in using data to support better decisions. Benefits Opportunity to contribute directly to data-driven business decision-making. Hands-on experience working with business reporting, dashboards, and data visualization. Exposure to tools such as Microsoft Excel, Tableau, Power BI, and Google Data Studio. Opportunity to collaborate with multiple business functions and stakeholders. Development of practical analytical, reporting, and data interpretation skills. Exposure to data governance, data quality, and privacy practices. Opportunity to work on both recurring reporting processes and ad hoc analytical projects. Professional environment focused on accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement. southparkcommons-meesho:lever:19d34992-c.description: About the Team We’re revolutionizing the way India shops — and we need curious, driven minds like yours to lead the charge.Imagine seeing your favorite influencer in a show-stopping outfit, only to find there’s no way to buy it online. Frustrating, right? That’s the very gap we’re solving at Meesho through Content Commerce and additionally trying to shape more influencers become entrepreneurs— and you could be at the heart of it.As our next Senior Associate – CC, you’ll play a pivotal role in solving one of the most common yet unexplored problems in Indian e-commerce: how to connect aspiration to access. thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Urological Specialists of Northwest Indiana (USNI) - powered by Urology Alliance. Are you ready to elevate your career in a dynamic and supportive environment? Our thriving private practice urology group is actively seeking a passionate and skilled Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant to become part of our expanding team in 2026! As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), USNI is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers USNI to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our clinicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Prime Location : Our modern clinic is conveniently located in Highland, IN, with easy access to Hammond and nearby communities. Flexible Work-Life Balance : Enjoy a Monday through Friday schedule with flexibility to fit your lifestyle. Comprehensive Patient Care: Deliver high-quality care across both outpatient clinic settings and hospital rounds in a collaborative, patient-centered environment. Steady Patient Volume : See an average of 30 patients per day , allowing you to maintain meaningful patient relationships without compromising quality. Oncology-Focused Practice: This role emphasizes oncology care and requires at least one year of oncology experience. Competitive Compensation : We offer a guaranteed annual base salary with additional incentives and benefits, ensuring a rewarding career path. General Overview: Lake and Porter Counties are located in Northwest Indiana, within commuting distance to Chicago. Both counties offer a blend of suburban and rural settings with a low cost of living compared to Chicago. Known for a family-friendly environment, diverse recreational options, and close-knit communities. Housing & Cost of Living: Housing in Lake and Porter Counties is relatively affordable, with options from suburban neighborhoods to rural properties. Crown Point in Lake County and Valparaiso in Porter County are popular towns with well-rated schools, safe neighborhoods, and modern amenities. Education: Both counties provide strong K-12 public school systems. Higher education options include Purdue University Northwest in Lake County (Hammond) and Valparaiso University in Porter County. Valparaiso University, in particular, offers a vibrant campus community with comprehensive programs. Recreation & Nature: Indiana Dunes National Park, located in Porter County, offers beaches, hiking trails, and water sports along Lake Michigan. Numerous parks, trails, golf courses, and family-friendly spaces in both counties support an active, outdoor lifestyle. Community Life & Amenities: Both counties have rich cultural amenities, including farmer’s markets, festivals, community theaters, and art galleries. Valparaiso’s historic downtown in Porter County and Crown Point’s town square in Lake County provide charming dining, shopping, and entertainment. There’s a mix of national retail chains and locally-owned shops, with year-round community events fostering community connectedness. Transportation & Commuting: Lake and Porter Counties are connected to Chicago via the South Shore Line commuter rail. Both counties are accessible by major highways (I-65, I-80/94), simplifying commutes. Gary/Chicago International Airport in Lake County offers regional flights, while Chicago’s O’Hare and Midway Airports are about an hour’s drive. Safety: Suburban communities in Lake and Porter Counties generally have low crime rates. Crown Point in Lake County and towns in Porter County like Chesterton and Valparaiso are known for safety and family-friendliness.
